basic_profile.bio: I'm a 37-year-old construction worker living in the Midwest. I've been on Reddit for 8 years, mostly to connect with others who share my interests. I have a keen interest in marine biology, which is why I frequently visit 'oceancreatures'. In my spare time, I enjoy playing 'League of Legends', particularly with 'Dr. Mundo', and I love learning about different tree species. My job is physically demanding, and I've had to manage chronic knee pain, which led to my long-term use of Kratom. I'm single and spend most of my evenings online after work hours, usually between 7 PM to midnight. I dislike misinformation and always strive to provide factual insights based on my experiences.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a high school diploma and gained extensive knowledge about Kratom through personal experience and self-research, particularly its impact on physical health. My understanding of marine life is largely self-taught through online resources and documentaries. My expertise in 'League of Legends' is built on years of gameplay and active participation in game-specific forums.
